title: Simulates a clonal composite — composite
text: Considering direct (DGE) indirect genetic effects (IGE) selected clones, function simulates grids. Clones positioned differently simulation, enables modification focal tree-neighbour dynamics. simulation, expected mean clone predicted using following equation (Ferreira et al., 2023): $$\hat{y}_{ij} = \hat{\mu} + \hat{d}_i + \sum^n_{\neq j}{\hat{c}_j}$$ \(d_i\) DGE ith focal tree, \(c_j\) IGE jth neighbour. d.weight = TRUE, IGE divided distance focal tree neighbours: $$\hat{y}_{ij} = \hat{\mu} + \hat{d}_i + \sum^n_{\neq j}{\frac{1}{dist_{ij}} \times \hat{c}_j}$$

title: Preparations to fit a genetic-spatial competition models for forestry — prepfor
text: Three methods available estimating competition intensity building \(\mathbf{Z}_c\), genetic competition matrix: Muir (2005): "MU" average competition intensity inverse distance focal plant neighbours: $$f_{D_v} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{d_R^2 + d_C^2}}$$ $$f_{R_v} = \frac{1}{d_R}$$ $$f_{C_v} = \frac{1}{d_C}$$ \(f_{D_v}\), \(f_{R_v}\) \(f_{C_v}\) average competition intensities diagonal, row, column directions \(v^{th}\) clone, respectively; \(d_R\) \(d_C\) inter-row inter-column distances. Cappa Cantet (2008): "CC" average competition intensity depends number neighbours direction $$f_{D_v} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2(n_{C_v} + n_{R_v}) + n_{D_v}}}$$ $$f_{R_v} = \sqrt{\frac{2}{2(n_{C_v} + n_{R_v}) + n_{D_v}}}$$ $$f_{C_v} = \sqrt{\frac{2}{2(n_{C_v} + n_{R_v}) + n_{D_v}}}$$ \(n_{D_v}\), \(n_{R_v}\) \(n_{C_v}\) number neighbours diagonal, row column directions \(v^{th}\) clone, respectively. Note , case, assumed distance rows columns . Costa e Silva Kerr (2013): "SK" average competition intensity depends distance focal tree neighbours, number neighbours direction: $$f_{D_v} = \frac{p}{\sqrt{(n_{R_v} p^4) + (n_{R_v} p^2) + (n_{C_v} p^2) + (n_{D_v} p^2) + n_{C_v}}}$$ $$f_{R_v} = f_{D_v} \sqrt{1 + p^2}$$ $$f_{C_v} = \frac{f_{D_v} \sqrt{1 + p^2}}{p}$$ \(p = \frac{d_C}{d_R}\). overall competition intensity factor (\(CIF\)) estimated taking mean competition intensities provided equations described , mean number neighbours direction: $$CIF = \overline{n_D} \overline{f_D} + \overline{n_R} \overline{f_R} + \overline{n_C} \overline{f_C}$$
